focus_areas: Stratification continuity: Ensure rock layers do not warp or disappear illogically.
Vegetation anchoring: Verify trees/bushes have realistic contact points with the rock/ground.
Edge definition: Check the silhouette of the cliff against the sky for haloing or blur.
Texture coherence: Look for repetitive patterns in the rock grain that suggest tiling artifacts.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the tree branches and the rock face at the top right. AI often struggles with complex occlusion here. Also, verify if the talus slope at the bottom has individual stone definition or if it blurs into a noisy texture.
